mechanism: Ranitidine inhibits CYP450 metabolism (particularly CYP2D6 and CYP3A4), potentially increasing prochlorperazine plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine side effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis, QT prolongation); consider alternative H2-blocker or dose adjustment if interaction suspected.
